scripts.//dev:zero-cache: zero-cache reads its own environment rather than ours, so .env is sourced here instead of by any of our code. ZERO_UPSTREAM_DB defaults to DATABASE_URL: it is the same database, and writing the password twice is how the two drift apart. `:=` inside `set -a` exports the assignment, which is why it sits before `set +a`.
scripts.dev:zero-cache: sh -c 'set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; : "${ZERO_UPSTREAM_DB:=$DATABASE_URL}"; : "${ZERO_APP_PUBLICATIONS:=zero_data}"; set +a; cd apps/server && exec pnpm exec zero-cache-dev'
